# All prefix questions can still omit an intermediate loss

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Two reached positions in one connected process agree on every finite branch question over complete blocks and all their nonempty prefixes, yet differ in intermediate loss. No formula in the whole prefix language translates that loss question. Exposing the suffix at the reached position restores the distinction, which every native exact account must preserve.

Canonical source: [Granularity.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Granularity.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- One explicit six-position, three-event relation; prefix recipes are begin and begin/finish, with empty atomic vocabulary.
- The nontranslation theorem needs no reduction; impossibility of extending an already merged encoding additionally uses Reduced.

Both positions are reached from the same admitted origin/enter source. The difference comes from reached positions and the availability of finish, without a free loss predicate. These are witnesses under a supplied law, not empirical observations.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1: 23 new declarations / 279 closure audits; all 23 new use standard dependencies, 3 include classical choice; 256 inherited audits separate. Frozen source/log/checker hashes are bound. Author counterreview, no independent-agent acceptance.

Refutes sufficiency of this specified prefix language, not every coarse description or generative grounding. Richer atomic tests or nonreduced codes may retain the distinction; reality is not shown to require these event names.

The periphery’s ExplanatoryGranularityBoundary.unfolding is defined by a match with an overlapping wildcard case and compiles through propext, so no statement mentioning it has an empty axiom report; the witness is therefore stated on the core frame Midway.frame: the same six configurations, three moves and six steps, the steps an inductive relation. The two branches from one origin (Midway.shared_origin) are alike in completed blocks (Midway.same_completed_tests) and in blocks of every nonempty prefix (Midway.same_prefix_tests, by a bisimulation, so passing the same tests needs no premise), while the loss midway is real (Midway.internal_loss): no test of prefixes reads it (Midway.no_prefix_reading), every description exact for the finer tests keeps the two apart (Midway.codes_apart), exposing the suffix where the course stands recovers the difference (Midway.resumption_recovers_loss), and a description reduced to the prefix tests cannot be extended to an exact account of the finer tests (Midway.reduced_prefix_cannot_extend). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proofs and their receipts keep their scope; a correspondence between the periphery’s model and Midway is not proved (it would have to mention the periphery’s definition).
